sections.h2: Urban rail is more than half of the EIB's €3.8bn India lending since 1993

chart.title: Urban rail alone accounts for €2.2bn of the €3.8bn EIB total
chart.source: EIB press release 2025-388; European Commission COM(2024) 556 final.

sections.means: Urban rail is the largest EIB line in the post, so the EU's India money mostly builds cities rather than factories.
sections.todo: Readers should check whether an announced Global Gateway loan is infrastructure or manufacturing tech transfer before counting it as the latter.

sections.h2: The two valued direct ECA deals are smaller than a single KfW infrastructure loan

chart.title: Priced direct deals run €372m and €950m, far below the €2.15bn KfW loan
chart.sub: Direct ECA-backed India deals with a published value, €m.
chart.source: Euler Hermes AG; SACE; European Commission COM(2024) 556 final.
rows: Euler Hermes, SMS hot strip mill (2023)

sections.means: The two valued direct deals are smaller than a single KfW infrastructure loan, and the other two list no value.
sections.todo: Any claim that ECA-backed deals drive manufacturing in India should be tested against these deal values first.

sections.h2: 20 of the EU's 27 member states run an export credit agency

chart.title: Seven member states have no export credit agency listed for 2023
chart.sub: EU member states by export credit agency status in the 2023 return.
chart.source: European Commission, annual review of member-state export credit agencies (2023 return).
rows: Member states without an ECA listed

sections.means: Most EU member states run an export credit agency, but the Commission's 2023 list does not include the other seven.
sections.todo: Anyone comparing EU export finance should use the 20-agency list in the 2023 return and not assume all 27 states are covered.
